esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x76. Added the ms5837.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the pressure and water temperature set on the sliders: passes
